cover: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: 16:9 keynote cover background for Blocky Studio, an educational AI creation product inspired by nested programming blocks. Create a refined editorial 3D still life: six large matte ceramic and softly frosted interlocking programming-block forms assembled into one coherent stepped sculpture, suggesting human construction and visible logical structure. Sculptural nested contours, tactile bevels, restrained studio materials, no node-link networks. Palette drawn from the actual product: deep blue-black #17212C backdrop, saturated teal, muted lavender purple, a small warm amber accent, soft ivory edge highlights. Composition: sculpture wholly in the right 45% of frame, extending from x55% to x96%, vertical center around 55%; the left 52% is quiet nearly uniform dark negative space for editable white Chinese title text to be added later. A soft grounded shadow and a single elegant side light, subtle real depth, crisp cinematic product lighting. Sophisticated and memorable, suitable for an entrepreneurship pitch, not childish. No text, no lettering, no numbers, no logos, no UI, no people, no tiny floating symbols, no glow trails, no gradients that reduce text contrast. Landscape 16:9, high resolution.
product: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: clean landscape illustration for an educational AI product presentation. A refined 3D still life of three distinct but visually related nested programming-block constructions arranged horizontally on a warm off-white background #F7F7F3: left is a short modular teal stack with one lavender block about to fit into its top notch; center is an orderly nested lavender and teal structure with a small amber inset piece; right is a completed upright open structure framing a simple ivory sheet shape. These are abstract illustrative objects, not software UI. Show visible interlocking logic and tactile matte ceramic surfaces, restrained soft studio shadows, orthographic three-quarter camera and generous clear space between the three objects. Each group same scale, occupies lower and middle half; calm empty top 20% for editable labels later. Palette consistent teal #007C73, lavender #7050B5, amber #AE6800, ivory. Premium editorial illustration for a Chinese education and technology startup deck, elegant not toy-like. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no UI panels, no people, no node-link diagrams, no busy background. Wide 16:9 composition.
